title: Pairwise exclusive-OR construction
statement: Given pairs of Boolean circuit trees $(A,B)$ and $(C,D)$, define their combined pair to be $((A\land D)\lor(B\land C),\,(A\land C)\lor(B\land D))$, where each conjunction and disjunction is represented by a circuit node.
